facts.text: Nimb is in the heart of Copenhagen and offers views to Tivoli Gardens amusement park.
facts.excerpt: In the heart of Copenhagen, you find unforgettable Nimb that offers views to the magical Tivoli Gardens amusement park.

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a 1909 Moorish-inspired palace.
facts.excerpt: Housed in a 1909 Moorish-inspired palace, Nimb blends its storied heritage with impeccable design and exceptional guest care.

facts.text: Rooms and suites are uniquely decorated.
facts.excerpt: Nimb Hotel's 38 uniquely decorated rooms and suites blend intimate charm with timeless magic.

facts.text: The roof terrace has an emerald green pool where you can swim against a built-in tide, with views of Copenhagen and Tivoli Gardens.
facts.excerpt: Jump in the emerald green pool and swim against the built-in tide. Rinse off in the outdoor shower or lounge away your time with a view of Copenhagen and Tivoli Gardens.

facts.text: Nimb Wellness has a vaulted Moroccan hammam with a 50°C steam bath.
facts.excerpt: At the heart of Nimb Wellness, you find our beautifully vaulted Moroccan hammam. Here, you can relax in the 50°C steam bath after training

facts.text: Hotel guests enjoy free access to Nimb Wellness, including the fitness studio, hammam and relaxation area.
facts.excerpt: Nimb Club members and hotel guests enjoy free access to Nimb Wellness, including the fitness studio, hammam and relaxation area.

facts.text: The wellness area offers cardio training in a specially designed 34-degree hot room.
facts.excerpt: Nimb Wellness also offers access to cardio-training in a specially designed 34 degrees hot room.

facts.text: The rooms are spread across the original 1909 palace building and a 2017 extension called Tivoli Corner, designed by Pei Cobb Freed & Partners.
facts.excerpt: the original 1909 palace building and the more modern 2017 extension, known as Tivoli Corner, designed by architects Pei Cobb Freed & Partners

facts.text: Some rooms in the original wing have old wood-burning fireplaces.
facts.excerpt: old wood-burning fireplaces in the original wing

facts.text: The rooms pair Nordic minimalism with Asian opulence.
facts.excerpt: the overall look is remarkably consistent: Nordic minimalism meets Asian opulence

facts.text: Hotel guests get unlimited entries and rides at Tivoli Gardens.
facts.excerpt: The magical Tivoli Gardens to which, as a hotel guest, you get access to unlimited entries—and rides.

facts.text: Evening turndown service delivers sweet treats, foot baths and face masks to the bedside.
facts.excerpt: the turndown service each evening delivers sweet treats as well as foot baths and face masks to your bedside

facts.text: Nimb Brasserie serves French cuisine morning, noon and evening.
facts.excerpt: French temptations morning, noon and evening

facts.text: Nimb Bar serves cocktails and afternoon teas under chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Nimb Bar entices you with well-crafted cocktails and afternoon teas served under the splendid chandeliers

facts.text: In 2007 the building was updated and reopened as a luxury boutique hotel.
facts.excerpt: In 2007, the building underwent a massive update and reopened as a luxury boutique hotel.

facts.text: Nimb is owned by Tivoli Gardens.
facts.excerpt: Nimb is owned by Tivoli Gardens

facts.text: Nimb is right by Copenhagen's central station.
facts.excerpt: Nimb is right by the central station

facts.text: Not all rooms are wheelchair accessible, though all floors are served by an elevator.
facts.excerpt: All floors at Nimb are serviced by an elevator, making the entire hotel easily accessible for wheelchair users. However, not all rooms are wheelchair accessible

facts.text: The minimum age for the wellness facilities is 16, though younger children with an adult are welcome in the hammam and relaxation area.
facts.excerpt: The minimum age to access the facilities is 16 years. However, younger children in the company of an adult are welcome in the hammam and relaxation area.

facts.text: Nimb Roof is a rooftop bar in the summer months.
facts.excerpt: During the summer months, Nimb Roof transforms into a stylish cocktail bar in Copenhagen

facts.text: Nimb was named a Condé Nast Traveller Triple Crown winner.
facts.excerpt: We are deeply honored to be named a Condé Nast Traveller Triple Crown winner!

facts.text: The wellness area is 300 square metres with a hammam, steam area and relaxation area with free refreshments.
facts.excerpt: We have created a true 300 m2 oasis for you at Nimb. Experience the wonderful hammam and steam area with beautiful changing rooms and a relaxation area with free access to refreshments.
